FINDING: F-01
KIND: factual
SEVERITY: blocking
WHERE: Context, Acceptance Criteria, Test Plan
EVIDENCE: docs/specs/exporter.md:16 promises an image that exports widget metrics. The only criterion at line 28 and its proof at line 34 check that --health prints ok. A program that exports no metrics can satisfy every criterion.
PROPOSAL: Define the observable metrics interface and expected widget metrics. Add criteria and proof that exercise that interface and verify the expected values.

FINDING: F-02
KIND: factual
SEVERITY: blocking
WHERE: Design, Acceptance Criteria, Test Plan
EVIDENCE: docs/specs/exporter.md:5 promises an image that ships. Line 24 names acme/widget-exporter but identifies its publishing path only as that repository's release workflow. The sole proof builds locally; it establishes neither compatibility with the satellite's build path nor publication. The pinned conventions/delivery.md requires the actual build and publication paths and a check that rebuilds artifacts through those paths.
PROPOSAL: Identify the satellite workflow, source handoff and published image reference. Add proof for its actual build path and a criterion establishing that the intended image is published and retrievable.
